name: Wave swap
what: A title that changes into another: the first one's letters leave along a wave one after another while the second's ride the same wave in and settle.

learned_from.what: a two-line title flowing out along a wave and coming back as a new one

motion: in 12 f; out along a wave in 3 legs of 8 f (sine), 2 f apart; the new one in the same way, settling with a slow end
